spans.s: 1. ऋ the seventh vowel of the Sanskṛt alphabet and peculiar to it (resembling the sound of ri in merrily).
2. ऋ ind. an interjection expressing laughter, L.
a sound inarticulate or reiterated as in stammering, W.
[cf. Gk. ὄρ-νυ-μι, ἐρ-έ-της, ἀρό-ω, &c. : Zend √ ir : Lat. or-ior, re-mus, aro : Goth. ar-gan : Angl.Sax. ār : Old High Germ. ruo-dar, ar-an : Lith. ir-ti, ‘to row’; ar-ti, ‘to plough’.]

1. ॠ the eighth vowel of the alphabet (the corresponding long vowel to ऋ and resembling the sound of ri in marine, but after labials more like ru; it generally only appears in some forms of nouns in ऋ, viz. in the gen. pl. of all genders, in the acc. pl. m. and f. and in nom. acc. and voc. pl. n.)
2. ॠ ind. an interjection of terror, L.
a particle used at the beginning of a sentence, L.
